title: PunchPace routine
description: One routine as the app stores, syncs and exports it (export files hold them in "routines"). cv is the format version: core/routine.js migrates older routines up to it. Durations are in seconds.

id.description: Unique per account. Presets use p-<name>.

icon.description: Icon name; anything else shows the default icon.

prep.description: Get ready time before the first round.

sec.description: Count length: seconds per count of a reps block, and per move of a boxing call, unless the block sets its own tempo.

hold.description: Wait for a tap before each next round or each next block. Absent: start automatically.

days.description: Weekdays it is planned on, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Absent: any day.

when.description: Part of the day. Absent: anytime.

skip.description: Days it was skipped (kept for 14 days).

add.description: Days it was added to today (kept for 14 days).

streak.description: false: logged, but not counted for streaks.

upd.description: Last change (ms since 1970); sync keeps the newest copy.

sound.description: The routine's own sound & voice, used instead of Settings.

voiceURI.description: A device voice; empty: the language's default.

volume.description: Not used: the volume is one per device, for the whole app. Kept so older data stays valid.

block.description: One part of a round. Fields of another type can stay behind when a block's type is changed; they are ignored.

type.description: reps: counted repetitions · timed: work for a time · boxing: called combos · seq: steps in order · rest.

work.description: timed, boxing, rest: duration · seq: time per step.

tempo.description: reps, boxing: own count length in seconds; 0 or absent: the routine's sec.

mode.description: guided: the app counts · tap: tap for each rep.

cues.description: Comma-separated, said instead of the count numbers.

combos.description: One combo per line; moves split by spaces or dashes (1-2 slip). Known moves get a stable id (core/steps.js MOVES).

order.description: Which combo is called next. Absent: random.

vfit.description: Calls: '' or wait = the voice, waiting when it is slow · pace = said faster, tones when too fast · tones = tones only.

steps.description: seq: one step per line; @6, @1:30 or @tap at the end gives a step its own time or waits for a tap.
